subject: Request: temporary credit bridge to recover lapsed trial
messages:
From: Aditi Shah <aditi@brightbyte.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightByte Procurement <procurement@brightbyte.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Trial expired — can we get a short top-up to finish evaluation?

Hi Jordan,

Hope youre well. Weve been testing Redwood for the last 3 weeks as part of a POC and ran into a timing problem: our sandbox credits expired yesterday and a number of evaluation jobs (NLP model-to-prod smoke tests) didnt complete.

Were targeting an internal demo for execs on Friday and losing those final runs jeopardizes the deck. Is there any possibility of a short, conditional top-up (48-72 hours) or a small promo extension so we can finish the last two test cases? We can share logs/usage snapshot and a short plan for remediation.

Attached: usage_snapshot_May19.csv and a one-page POC recap.

Thanks,
Aditi Shah
Head of ML, BrightByte AI
aditi@brightbyte.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Aditi Shah <aditi@brightbyte.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial expired — can we get a short top-up to finish evaluation?

Hi Aditi,

Thanks for the heads up and for submitting the snapshot — I can see the burst that hit the sandbox yesterday. Were happy to help get you to the finish line.

Proposed approach:
- Temporary bridge: grant a 72-hour sandbox top-up equivalent to $500 in credits tied to RD-47821.
- Conditions: limited to the project scopes listed in your POC recap, one-time extension, and well need a short confirmation that the exec demo is scheduled (time/date).
- Follow-up: Ill loop in Procurement internally for approval and confirm any billing/terms if you want to convert to paid shortly after the demo.

If that works, Ill start the approval thread and get the credits loaded by EOD tomorrow. Can you confirm the executive demo time?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Trial expired — short credit bridge request (BrightByte, RD-47821)

Kim / Marissa / Sean,

BrightByte (Aditi) is requesting a short, one-time sandbox top-up to finish an exec demo — ask is 48-72 hours. Details below + they attached usage snapshot and POC recap.

Why: POC is nearly complete, exec demo Friday (they say). Upside: high chance to convert if demo goes well; BrightByte has engaged Solutions and is expecting a scoped conversion conversation next week.

Suggested approval: $500 one-time credit (72 hours), tagged to RD-47821. Approve conditionally: require exec demo time confirmation and limit to the project IDs in the POC doc.

Risks: potential abuse if we dont limit scope. We should mark the account for extra monitoring and set a hard quota for the top-up.

Marissa, can you confirm we can load a $500 sandbox top-up today if approved?
Kim, any billing or policy flags I should know about?
Sean, suggest we add a monitoring alert on their account for the window.

Thanks — Jordan
